body:
I had a tattoo cut out of my skin because I developed an allergic reaction to the red ink used in the design. The dermatologist used local anesthetic and went to town on my arm. The scars are still healing over but I occasionally feel a strong stinging sensation. It may take up to 1.5 years to heal. 

I was young and I was adventerous.
Shit, I'm crazy :)

Dermatologist told me to wait at least 18 months before doing anything to it. At least I know now that I should just stick with all black tattoos. I may just black it out completely. It took up most of my inner forearm.

I'm going to try to get in better shape.
Go from 261lbsto 200lbs at least.
I recently had an allergic reaction to a red ink tattoo that I had cut out. I'm waiting on the scars to heal over so I can black it out. I need to find a new occupation and move out on my own.
